STRATEGY: Parent slot 5 uses recent-10 cooperation rate, forced mutual-cooperation reset after 4 mutual D's, and forgiveness probabilities. The trace simulates slot 8 (cooperate until n>=98 if no opponent defections; otherwise probabilistic TFT with 5%/25% forgiveness and 85% cooperation when last_op C) and other slots (TFT-like, always-D, forgiving slot 11, slot 2). It proposes a revised strategy: always defect at n>=98, cooperate if opp_defects==0, defect with 5% forgiveness if defect_rate>0.6, 25% forgiveness otherwise, and 85% cooperation when last_op C.

STRATEGY: Parent is a probabilistic strategy that cooperates first, defects in the last 2 rounds, always defects if opponent defect rate > 0.8, punishes unprovoked defection with 80% D, tries to restore after mutual defection with 60% C, and cooperates 80% when opponent cooperated. The trace simulated this parent against slots 2, 9, 11, and TFT, and revised it by adding a provoked/unprovoked distinction, a 0.6 chronic-defector threshold, and a 50% cooperation chance after mutual defection.
